_comment: Floor 0: Tutorial Level - Teaches basic game mechanics
_educational_note: This floor is designed to onboard new players with step-by-step guidance
name: ECU Training Environment
description: A safe simulation environment designed to teach new processes about the ECU system. Here you'll learn movement, combat, item usage, and signal crafting before entering the real CAN Bus.

dimensions._comment: Smaller map for focused tutorial experience

generation._comment: Simple layout with clear rooms for each tutorial section
generation._note: Tutorial uses custom generation with predefined room layout

tutorial_sections._comment: Tutorial is divided into learning sections

sections.title: Movement & Exploration

messages.text: Welcome to the ECU Training Environment!
Use arrow keys or WASD to move around. Try exploring this room.
Good! You picked up an item. Press 'i' to view your inventory.

objectives: Pick up the Signal Boost item
Find the door to the next room

messages.text: This room contains a Training Dummy - a harmless entity for practice.
Move adjacent to an enemy and press Enter or Space to attack.
Great! Your attack dealt damage. Keep attacking to defeat the dummy.
Victory! You've defeated the training dummy and gained experience.
Enemies drop signals when defeated - useful for crafting!

sections.title: Items & Healing

messages.text: This room teaches you about consumable items.
Pick up the Signal Boost, then press 'i' to open inventory.
Select the Signal Boost and press 'u' to use it. This will restore HP.
Excellent! Items can heal, buff, or provide other benefits.
Always keep healing items in your inventory for emergencies!

objectives: Use a Signal Boost to heal

messages.text: Final lesson: Signal Crafting! Combine signals to create powerful effects.
You should have sensor signals from defeating enemies. Press 'c' to craft.
Select 'Error Correction Routine' - it requires 2 sensor readings.
Success! Crafting consumed your signals and healed you.
Experiment with different signal combinations to discover recipes!
You've completed the tutorial! Take the stairs down to begin your journey.

enemy_spawns._comment: Training Dummy - Takes damage but never attacks
Very weak enemy for combat practice

item_spawns._comment: Starting healing item in movement room
More healing items in items room

stairs._comment: Only stairs down - tutorial is one-way

stairs_down._note: Stairs in final room after crafting lesson

difficulty._note: Player starts with bonus HP for safety

general_tips: Tip: Press 'h' anytime to view the help menu with all commands.
Tip: Your HP regenerates slowly outside of combat. Rest to heal!
Tip: Different enemies have different behaviors - observe their patterns.
Tip: Save your game frequently with 's' to preserve progress.
Tip: Some signals are consumed when crafting, others are reusable.
Tip: Explore thoroughly - hidden items and secrets await!
Tip: Status effects can buff or debuff you. Check the status bar.
Tip: Ranged enemies attack from distance. Close the gap quickly!
Tip: Items in your inventory have weight. Don't carry too much!
Tip: Read item descriptions carefully to understand their effects.
combat_tips: Combat Tip: Higher ground provides +1 defense bonus.
Combat Tip: Critical hits deal double damage! Build crit chance.
Combat Tip: Defense reduces incoming damage. Stack defense for survivability.
Combat Tip: Accuracy affects hit chance. Low accuracy = more misses.
Combat Tip: Some enemies are weak to certain signal types.
crafting_tips: Crafting Tip: Experiment with signal combinations to discover recipes.
Crafting Tip: Some recipes require special items or minimum floor level.
Crafting Tip: Reusable signals (marked *) aren't consumed when crafting.
Crafting Tip: Offensive recipes can damage multiple enemies at once.
Crafting Tip: Defensive recipes provide buffs and protection.

on_completion.text: Tutorial Complete! You've earned a Starter Pack for Floor 1.

metadata.author: Tutorial Designer
